name: Sanctions & coercion
value: US blockade of Iran; Graham Act in force
summary: US naval blockade of Iran continues; lifting it is central to talks
state: The US naval blockade of Iranian ports remains in force, with a third aircraft carrier heading to the region (AP, 3 Nov). Mediators are working on a framework to trade an end to strait attacks for lifting the blockade, and Iran also wants oil sanctions lifted. The Lindsey Graham Act, signed in October, expands secondary sanctions on Russia's trading partners.
for_you: Firms trading with Iran- or Russia-linked counterparties face higher compliance risk.
rubric_hit: Major sanctions in force; no new escalation = Watch

why: Sanctions are now a frontline weapon; secondary sanctions and asset seizures fragment global finance and trade.
drivers: Russia/Iran sanctions packages, secondary sanctions, frozen-asset decisions, export controls.
